properties.decision:
Asked 2026-10-03, in chat: a server started with --read-only (stdio, --http or --serve-shared) where no design store exists currently CREATES an empty store — what should it do instead? Three options were put: "Serve the latent surface", "Refuse to start", "Keep creating it". Anthony chose "Serve the latent surface".

WHAT IT MEANS:
- The server starts and creates NOTHING: not the store's first byte, not the version stamp, nothing beside the store (a --serve-shared server publishes no rendezvous).
- It serves the latent surface, the one --only-if-present serves where no design has been started, on the transport it was given: the handshake says there is no design store and that --read-only creates none; describe_designs answers; reflow2_start_design is refused (item 1b).
- A store that appears later (an import, a restore, a session that writes) is served read-only by the same server, with no restart. Over HTTP, /readyz answers 503 until then.
- "May this open create a store?" is ONE rule (crates/reflow2-mcp/src/opening.rs), asked by the one-shot door, the --shared client, the latent surface and every serving mode.
properties.name: ACCEPTED 2026-10-03 — a server started with --read-only where there is no design store serves the latent surface and creates nothing (over refusing to start, and over creating the store)
properties.rationale:
THE TWO OPTIONS NOT TAKEN, and why:
- REFUSE TO START. Item 1's objection stands: an MCP client whose server exits before the handshake is left with no server and no reason; it reports a closed connection, indistinguishable from reflow2 never having been configured (req:never-silently-absent; the degraded surface exists because of exactly this).
- KEEP CREATING IT. --read-only promises to change nothing, and its help said "no design store is created where there is none"; that sentence was false for these servers from the day it was written (fact:a-read-only-server-creates-an-empty-store-where-there-is-none-2026-10-03). An empty store made by a read-only server answers every read as a healthy empty design, with nothing saying it was made by looking.
THE LATENT SURFACE answers both: the server is there and says why there is no design, and nothing is created. The cost the finding named — it changes what an operator's read-only server serves on an empty path — is the point: what it served before was an empty design nobody made.
